name: GET /api/users - List the team roster
description: Returns the users who can own a lead, oldest first, as the public projection only - the password hash is never included. Pass active=false to include deactivated accounts; the default returns active users only. Protected by the authenticate guard, so the Authorization header is required on this GET. Deliberately NOT admin-gated: routing configuration, ownership reassignment and coverage all need to name a colleague, and hiding the roster from the operators who must route to it would make those screens unusable. QA: depends on register and login; register also guarantees the roster is non-empty.

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
